campaign_optimizer_seed_rule: 31000 + 100 * context_size_index + context_seed, where context_size_index is 0,1,2,3 for 250,500,1000,2000
family_selection: lowest mean global development Brier; equal-region Brier tie-breaker within 1e-6; then prefer RBF
campaign_cost_model: 80 development fits (two families x ten contexts x four sizes) plus 40 final fits using the selected family
stopping_rule: Do not launch the campaign if the pilot-rate projection exceeds 7200 wall seconds
